module: Flowgraph node "Activity Attempt Stars" (category once_instant, tags activity/mission). Adds the completed stars to an attempt: each custom bool input pin (pin name = star key) is written into attempt.unlockedStars. Fixed input and output "attempt" (attemptData). Only the bool type is allowed for manual pins.
notes: A nil value on a pin becomes false in unlockedStars. The attempt table is modified in place then returned.

workOnce.desc: For each non-fixed, non-flow input pin, sets attempt.unlockedStars[name] = pin value (or false), then outputs attempt.
